summary: Biotin is a B vitamin involved in energy metabolism of carbohydrates, fats and proteins.

functions.description: Biotin is a B vitamin involved in energy metabolism of carbohydrates, fats and proteins.

foodSourceRules.notes: Exact source-backed 100 g profiles; missing composition is not zero.

deficiency.overview: Deficiency is rare in the United States; genetic conditions, alcohol dependence and some life stages warrant professional assessment.
deficiency.medicalBoundary: Symptoms are nonspecific and cannot diagnose a nutrient deficiency. Diagnosis may require clinical evaluation and appropriate laboratory testing.

excess.overview: High supplemental biotin can distort laboratory results, including some thyroid-related tests. Tell the laboratory and clinician about use.
excess.medicalBoundary: No upper limit is an intake goal. Seek professional or medical advice before changing supplement or medication use.

interactions.counterparty: Medicines discussed in the linked NIH ODS fact sheet
interactions.description: Some antiseizure medicines can lower biotin levels. Hair or nail changes alone do not establish a need for supplements.
interactions.limitations: Informational summary, not a complete interaction list or an instruction to change medicines.
